title: Water Log
description: Append-only record of every water bottle logged per day. Each row = one bottle event (one tap on the entry page). There is no numeric edit path — undo deletes the newest row of a given bottle size for a date, on the editor page.

log_id.description: Stable primary key for this log entry. UUID v4. Never reused or reassigned.

user_id.description: Identifier of the user who logged this entry. Use 'default' for single-user deployments. FK to users table (future). Required now to support multi-user without a schema migration later.

log_date.description: Date the water was drunk, the device's local date at tap time. ISO 8601 date format YYYY-MM-DD.

bottle.description: Which of the two fixed bottle sizes was tapped.

fl_oz.description: Fluid ounces for this bottle event. 32 for big, 26 for small. Not user-entered; derived from bottle at tap time and stored so historical totals do not shift if the fixed amounts ever change.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this log entry was created. Immutable after insert.
